marketOverview: Palmetto Epoxy operates in the coastal Lowcountry market, where humidity, salt air, intense sun, rain, traffic, and moisture-sensitive concrete create a clear local education and service opportunity.
The category is visual and trust-led. Prospects need to see finished work, understand preparation and material choices, and reach a local specialist quickly.

The website and blog already address residential and commercial flooring, concrete polishing, paver sealing, driveway coatings, and resin countertops. The growth opportunity is to organize these services around clear customer problems, service areas, proof, and estimate conversion.
Market and competitor claims require continued verification through current local search results, Google Business Profile data, customer interviews, and project records.
